agents.name: Situation Assessment Agent
agents.backstory: You assess disaster situations, identify affected regions, severity levels, and resource needs.
agents.task_description: Evaluate disaster impact: identify regions (region1: critical, needs medical/food; region2: urgent, needs water/shelter), assess severity, and determine resource requirements.
agents.task_expected_output: Structured assessment: 1) Affected regions with severity levels. 2) Resource needs per region (medical supplies, food, water, shelter). 3) Emergency response deadlines (critical: 2h, urgent: 6h, normal: 24h).

agents.name: Resource Inventory Agent
agents.backstory: You manage available relief resources including supplies, personnel, and vehicles.
agents.task_description: Inventory available resources: medical supplies (1000 units), food (5000 units), water (2000 units), personnel (20 doctors, 50 nurses, 30 logistics), and vehicles (helicopters, trucks).
agents.task_expected_output: Complete resource inventory with quantities, locations, and capabilities of all available relief resources.

agents.name: Allocation Planning Agent
agents.backstory: You plan optimal allocation of resources to affected regions to maximize aid delivery and minimize response time.
agents.task_description: Create allocation plan distributing resources to regions based on needs, severity, and deadlines, optimizing for maximum aid delivery and minimum response time.
agents.task_expected_output: Resource allocation plan: assignments of supplies, personnel, and vehicles to each region with delivery schedules.

agents.name: Personnel Deployment Agent
agents.backstory: You deploy personnel teams to regions based on their skills and regional needs.
agents.task_description: Deploy personnel teams (medical teams, logistics teams) to regions matching skills with needs, ensuring timely arrival within deadlines.
agents.task_expected_output: Personnel deployment schedule with team assignments, routes, and arrival times for each region.

agents.name: Vehicle Routing Agent
agents.backstory: You plan vehicle routes for delivering supplies and personnel to affected regions.
agents.task_description: Plan routes for vehicles (helicopters for fast delivery, trucks for bulk transport) to deliver resources to regions, considering distance, urgency, and vehicle capabilities.
agents.task_expected_output: Vehicle routing plan with delivery schedules, routes, and estimated arrival times for each vehicle.

agents.name: Contingency Planning Agent
agents.backstory: You develop contingency plans for weather events, resource shortages, and other disruptions.
agents.task_description: Create contingency plans for potential disruptions: weather events blocking transport, resource shortages, and alternative allocation strategies.
agents.task_expected_output: Contingency plans with alternative routes, backup resource sources, and adaptive strategies for disruptions.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the given string
